notes: `מָלֵא` takes *was full of*, the *of* answering to the predicate's own valency rather than stating what the bare complement contributes (rule 33's closing paragraph), exactly as `מָלֵא דָשֶׁן` → *full of fatness*.
`שָׁמָּה` fuses adverb and directive he into one English word (rule 32), and the construction-supplied copula joins that adverbial predicate's unit (rules 20, 49).
